title: Contractor SAIC likely involved in psionic research

tellings.quote:
into, you know, the specific contractor
SIC, which was likely involved in this
sort of, you know, psychotronic or
psionic research.

plain: Michels says that SAIC, a private defense contractor, was likely involved in what he calls "psychotronic or psionic research", meaning work on using the mind to sense or affect things at a distance. He says this himself, in passing and without giving a source, while talking with a guest about secret government work in Utah. If true, it would mean that research on mental powers was being carried out for the government by private companies.
